slides.business_issue: Extending the healing ministry demands a new kind of data-driven, consumer-first experience — one that meets 7 million patients when, where, and how they need care.
slides.big_idea: Adobe enables CHRISTUS Health to unify its newly integrated Epic data with consumer digital intelligence — powering personalized, HIPAA-compliant care journeys that drive preventive utilization, deepen patient loyalty, and position CHRISTUS as the undisputed digital-first health system across Texas, Louisiana, New Mexico, and Latin America.

slides.title: The opportunity: CHRISTUS has the data — now it needs the intelligence.

bullets.text: Serve 7M+ patients annually across TX, LA, NM and Latin America with a superior digital-first experience.
Complete CONNECT 2025: make telehealth and digital scheduling a growth centerpiece, meeting patients 'when, where, and how it's most convenient.'
Sustain 8%+ EBITDA margins amid Medicare reimbursement headwinds while investing in AI-driven care (Fitch A+ stable, 2026).
Accelerate AI-enabled early detection and preventive care utilization by capitalizing on the newly unified Epic data foundation.
Achieve 'One CHRISTUS' digital brand — sustaining #1–2 market position across all regions as retail health (CVS, Amazon) expands into Texas.
Clinical data is unified in Epic — but consumer, marketing, and health-plan data remain siloed, preventing a true 360° patient view.
Digital personalization is rules-based only: Sitecore CMS delivers location-aware content but has no AI-driven journey orchestration or real-time activation.
No enterprise CDP: patient outreach is campaign-by-campaign, not behavior-triggered — missing high-intent moments like abandoned scheduling or post-discharge gaps.
The 48% organic web traffic lift from the 2024 redesign is not yet converting to appointments at full potential — no A/B testing or personalization engine in place.
HIPAA-compliant first-party data activation is complex; industry-wide OCR enforcement on web tracking has created compliance exposure that must be architecturally resolved.
Unify Epic EHR, health plan, web, and app data into a HIPAA-compliant 360° patient profile — the single architecture Salesforce Marketing Cloud cannot match in healthcare.
Trigger automated, personalized care journeys at scale — post-discharge follow-ups, preventive screening nudges, open enrollment campaigns — across 7M patients.
Connect digital touchpoints to appointment bookings and care outcomes, giving VP Marketing Jeff Stewart true cross-channel attribution for the first time.
A/B test and AI-personalize ChristusHealth.org — turning the hard-won 48% traffic lift into measurably higher appointment conversions.
Comparable nonprofit health systems using Adobe's data and journeys suite have achieved 15–25% lift in online scheduling conversion and 30%+ improvement in care-gap closure.

slides.title: Path to power, business value & why now.

execs.name: Jon Manis
execs.title: SVP & Chief Information Officer  •  Lead champion
execs.mandate: Publicly mandates that CHRISTUS 'must become the technology company that delivers care — when, where, and how consumers need it.' Actively seeking bold AI and data projects in 2026. Primary sponsor for RT-CDP + AJO.

execs.name: Jeff Stewart
execs.title: VP Strategic Marketing  •  Primary buyer
execs.mandate: Built the 48% organic traffic lift and wants to sustain it through AI-driven personalization. Directly motivated to adopt Analytics + Target + AJO to convert traffic to appointments.

execs.name: Stuart James
execs.title: VP COO & Deputy CIO  •  Key evaluator
execs.mandate: Led the 3-year Epic unification. Insists 'data must be on point before AI can deliver.' Will scrutinize integration architecture and data governance rigor. Win him with the CDP story.

execs.name: Dr. Sam Bagchi
execs.title: EVP & Chief Clinical Officer  •  Clinical authority
execs.mandate: Sponsored Epic + ambient AI rollout. Will support data and journey solutions that demonstrably improve patient access and close care gaps.

values.heading: Preventive care at scale.
values.body: CHRISTUS' own campaigns demonstrate what's possible: a breast cancer HRA initiative connected 520 patients to screening, including 42 new cancer diagnoses. With Adobe Journey Optimizer, scale data-driven programs like this system-wide across 7M patients — automatically.

values.heading: Convert traffic to appointments.
values.body: The 2024 redesign drove a 48% lift in organic sessions. Adobe Target + Journey Optimizer turns that attention into action — industry benchmarks show 15–25% improvement in online scheduling conversion when AI personalization is applied to healthcare digital front doors.

values.heading: Marketing efficiency under margin pressure.
values.body: With Fitch flagging FY2026 Medicare reimbursement cuts, Adobe's unified platform reduces per-patient outreach cost through centralized omnichannel execution while improving reach — and gives the CFO clear attribution between marketing spend and service-line volumes.

why_now.label: ⚡ Why now
why_now.body: Epic went fully live March 2025 — CHRISTUS' data is ready NOW. 2026 is the optimization year. Medicare cuts are tightening margins. Retail health is expanding in Texas. CIO Manis is publicly calling for bold digital projects. Propose a 90-day RT-CDP + AJO pilot before FY2027 planning locks.
